info.title: AnyDB Universal API
info.description: Manage AnyDB teams, databases, records, shares, and webhooks through AnyDB's external integration API.

put.description: Completes an attachment upload in AnyDB.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

fileSize.description: The uploaded file size in bytes.

recordId.description: Optional AnyDB record ID for the upload target.

cellPosition.description: Optional AnyDB cell position for the completed upload.

importContent.description: Whether the completed upload should import content.

importAttachTo.description: Optional AnyDB parent ID to attach the imported upload to.

importTemplateId.description: Optional AnyDB template ID for the imported upload.

importFilename.description: Optional final filename for the completed upload.

importImage.description: Whether the completed upload should be treated as an image.
